before: The store's web address, kenswarehouse.com, shows an error page (404) instead of the store
Shoppers comparing furniture stores online have nothing to look at
The words on this concept come from the store's chamber listing; stock, photos and specials would come from the owner
after: A working page, today: phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
HTTPS that renews itself, with nothing to patch or let lapse
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for photos of the showroom floor, brands and specials once the store supplies them
